q: Describe a book that you enjoyed reading.
cue: and explain why you enjoyed it
ph: It was one of those books I couldn't put down.
What struck me most was...
h: 1 daqiqada 4 band bo'yicha reja yozing va har biriga 2–3 gap ajrating.

q: Describe a person who has influenced you.
cue: and explain how they influenced you
ph: I've always looked up to...
Thanks to her, I learned to...
h: Umumiy maqtov emas, bitta yorqin voqeani hikoya qiling.

q: Describe a place you would like to visit.
cue: and explain why you want to visit it
ph: It's been on my bucket list for years.
I'd love to see it with my own eyes.
h: Shart gaplar ishlating: If I went there, I would...

q: Describe a memorable journey you have taken.
cue: and explain why it was memorable
ph: It was a journey I'll never forget.
Looking back, it was worth every minute.
h: O'tgan zamonlarni aralashtiring: Past Simple + Past Continuous.

q: Describe a skill you would like to learn.
cue: why you want to learn it
and explain how it would help you
ph: I've always wanted to...
It would make a huge difference to my career.
h: Kelajak va shart iboralari: I'm planning to..., it would allow me to...

q: Describe a time you helped someone.
cue: and explain how you felt about it
ph: It wasn't a big deal, but it meant a lot to her.
I felt genuinely proud of myself.
h: Hikoya tuzilishi: boshlanish, muammo, harakat, natija va his.

q: Describe a gift you gave to someone.
cue: and explain how the person reacted
ph: I put a lot of thought into it.
Her face lit up when she opened it.
h: Reaksiyani jonli tasvirlang: lit up, was over the moon.

q: Describe a time when you were very busy.
ph: I had a lot on my plate that week.
I managed to get everything done in the end.
h: Vaqtni boshqarish so'zlari: prioritize, to-do list, deadline.

q: Describe a website or app that you use often.
cue: and explain why it is useful
ph: I can't imagine my day without it.
It saves me a lot of time.
h: Qanday ishlashini oddiy tushuntiring, keyin foydasini ayting.

q: Describe a festival or celebration in your country.
cue: and explain why it is important
ph: Navruz is the biggest celebration of the year for us.
Families get together and cook sumalak.
h: Madaniy so'zlar: tradition, ritual, festive atmosphere.

q: Describe a time you received good news.
ph: I could hardly believe my eyes.
I was on cloud nine for days.
h: His-tuyg'ularni kuchli sifatlar bilan bering: thrilled, overjoyed.

q: Describe a teacher you remember well.
cue: and explain why you remember them
ph: She had a gift for making difficult things simple.
Her lessons were never boring.
h: Xarakter sifatlari: patient, inspiring, strict but fair.

q: Describe a goal you want to achieve.
cue: what you are doing to achieve it
and explain why it is important to you
ph: My main goal right now is to get a band 7.
I'm taking it one step at a time.
h: Hozirgi harakatlaringizni Present Continuous bilan ko'rsating: I'm currently...

q: Describe a time you made a difficult decision.
cue: and explain how you felt afterwards
ph: I was in two minds for weeks.
In the end, I followed my heart.
h: Ikkilanish iboralari: weigh up the pros and cons, torn between.

q: Describe a sport you enjoy watching or playing.
cue: who you play or watch with
and explain why you enjoy it
ph: I've been hooked on football since childhood.
Nothing beats the atmosphere of a live match.
h: be hooked on, a die-hard fan, the atmosphere.

q: Describe a time you lost something important.
ph: My heart sank when I realized it was gone.
Luckily, someone handed it in.
h: Hikoyani taranglik bilan aytib bering, oxirida xulosa qiling.

q: Describe an interesting conversation you had.
cue: and explain why it was interesting
ph: We ended up talking for hours.
It completely changed my perspective.
h: Ko'chirma gap: He told me that..., she asked whether...

q: Describe a building that you like.
cue: and explain why you like it
ph: It's a stunning example of Islamic architecture.
The details on the tiles are incredible.
h: Me'morchilik so'zlari: dome, facade, intricate tilework.

q: Describe a time you were late for something.
ph: Of all days, the bus broke down that morning.
I learned to always leave early.
h: «Of all days» omadsizlikni ta'kidlaydigan tabiiy ibora.

q: Describe a piece of technology you find useful.
cue: and explain why it is useful
ph: It has made my life so much easier.
I use it for literally everything.
h: Oldin va keyin taqqoslang: Before I had it..., now...

q: Describe a family member you are close to.
cue: and explain why you are close
ph: We see eye to eye on almost everything.
She's always there for me.
h: Idiomalarni o'rinli ishlating: see eye to eye, through thick and thin.

q: Describe a time you tried something new.
ph: I decided to step out of my comfort zone.
It turned out to be easier than I expected.
h: step out of my comfort zone, give it a try, it turned out...

q: Describe a park or garden that you like.
cue: and explain why you like it
ph: It's a real oasis in the middle of the city.
I go there to clear my head.
h: Tasvirda sezgilardan foydalaning: nima ko'rasiz, eshitasiz, hidini sezasiz.

q: Describe a film that made you think.
cue: and explain why it made you think
ph: It really stuck with me for days.
It raises questions about...
h: Syujetni qisqa ayting, asosiy vaqtni filmning ta'siriga ajrating.

q: Describe a habit you want to change.
cue: how long you have had it
why you want to change it
and explain how you plan to change it
ph: I spend far too much time on my phone.
I'm trying to cut down gradually.
h: Reja iboralari: I'm going to..., I've started to..., step by step.

q: Describe an achievement you are proud of.
cue: and explain why you are proud of it
ph: All the hard work finally paid off.
It gave me a huge confidence boost.
h: Jarayonni ko'rsating: qiyinchilik + harakat + natija.

q: Describe a time you had to wait for something.
ph: The wait felt like forever.
I tried to keep myself busy.
h: Vaqt iboralari: for ages, it felt like forever, in the meantime.

q: Describe a shop you often visit.
cue: and explain why you like it
ph: It's a small family-run bakery near my house.
The staff always remember my order.
h: family-run, reasonably priced, friendly staff.

q: Describe a time you saw something beautiful in nature.
cue: and explain why it was beautiful
ph: It literally took my breath away.
I've never seen anything like it.
h: Kuchli sifatlar: breathtaking, stunning, spectacular.

q: Describe an advertisement you remember.
cue: and explain why you remember it
ph: It was so catchy that I still remember the song.
It was clever without being pushy.
h: Reklama so'zlari: catchy, slogan, target audience.

q: Why do some people prefer to live in cities rather than in the countryside?
ph: The main reason is probably job opportunities.
On the other hand, rural life is far less stressful.
h: Bir nechta sabab keltirib, har biriga misol bering. Ikkinchi tomonni ham tilga oling.

q: Should schools teach practical skills such as cooking and managing money?
ph: I'm strongly in favor of that.
Schools focus too much on exams.
h: Tuzilish: fikr + sabab + misol + xulosa.

q: How has technology changed the way people communicate?
ph: It has made communication instant.
However, face-to-face conversations are becoming rarer.
h: Present Perfect (has changed, has made) va ikkala tomon.

q: Do people today have less free time than in the past?
ph: In some ways, yes, because work never really stops now.
Smartphones blur the line between work and rest.
h: Ikki tomonlama javob: In some ways yes, but in other ways no.

q: What are the advantages and disadvantages of working from home?
ph: The biggest advantage is flexibility.
The main drawback is isolation.
h: advantage va drawback'ni aniq ajratib bering.

q: Is it better for children to grow up in a big family or a small one?
ph: Both have their merits.
Children from big families learn to share early.
h: Qolip: Both have their merits, but on balance I'd say...

q: Why is tourism important for a country's economy?
ph: It creates jobs and brings in foreign currency.
It also encourages investment in infrastructure.
h: Iqtisodiy so'zlar: revenue, employment, infrastructure.

q: Should governments spend more on public transport or on roads?
ph: I'd argue public transport should be the priority.
More roads often lead to more traffic.
h: Kutilmagan dalil fikringizni kuchaytiradi: more roads → more traffic.

q: How can people be encouraged to recycle more?
ph: Making it convenient is the key.
Some countries pay people for returning bottles.
h: Aniq yechimni ayting va boshqa davlatdan misol keltiring.

q: Are exams a good way to measure students' ability?
ph: They measure some skills, but not all of them.
Creativity is hard to test in an exam.
h: Ehtiyotkor iboralar: to some extent, not entirely, it depends.

q: What makes a good teacher?
ph: Above all, patience.
A good teacher makes students want to learn.
h: Muhimlik tartibida ayting: Above all..., Another key quality is...

q: Why do young people often want to study abroad?
ph: They want access to better universities.
It also broadens their horizons.
h: Kollokatsiyalar: broaden their horizons, gain independence.

q: Should famous people be role models for young people?
ph: Like it or not, they already are.
So they have a responsibility to behave well.
h: «Like it or not» bilan boshlash fikrni qiziqarli qiladi.

q: How might shopping change in the future?
ph: I expect online shopping to keep growing.
Physical shops may become places for experiences.
h: Kelajak iboralari: I expect..., it's likely that..., may well.

q: What are the effects of social media on teenagers?
ph: It can boost their confidence, but also their anxiety.
Constant comparison is a real problem.
h: Sabab-oqibat: lead to, result in, contribute to.

q: Is it important to preserve old buildings?
ph: Definitely, they tell the story of a city.
Places like Khiva attract visitors because of their history.
h: Mahalliy misol keltiring: Samarqand, Buxoro, Xiva.

q: Why do some people find it hard to save money?
ph: Advertising constantly pushes us to spend.
Paying by card makes spending feel less real.
h: Ikkita sabab keltirib, har birini bittadan tushuntiring.

q: Should parents limit their children's screen time?
ph: To some extent, yes.
But teaching self-control works better than strict bans.
h: Muvozanatli pozitsiya: yes, but...

q: How does sport benefit society as a whole?
ph: It keeps people healthy, which reduces pressure on hospitals.
It also brings communities together.
h: Faqat shaxsiy foyda emas, jamiyat darajasida o'ylang.

q: Why do people like to follow celebrities' lives?
ph: It's a form of escapism.
People are naturally curious about others.
h: Psixologik sabablar: escapism, curiosity, sense of connection.

q: What can cities do to reduce traffic congestion?
ph: Investing in public transport is the obvious solution.
Congestion charges have worked in some cities.
h: Bir nechta yechim sanab, bittasini batafsil tushuntiring.

q: Will artificial intelligence replace teachers?
ph: I doubt it will replace them completely.
AI can support teachers, but not replace the human connection.
h: Ehtimollik iboralari: I doubt..., it's unlikely that..., may well.

q: How important is it to learn about other cultures?
ph: It's more important than ever in a globalized world.
It helps people avoid stereotypes.
h: Zamonaviy kontekst: in a globalized world, nowadays.

q: Why do some people volunteer without being paid?
ph: For many, it gives a sense of purpose.
It's also a great way to gain experience.
h: Ichki va tashqi motivatsiyani ajrating.

q: Should university education be free?
ph: There are strong arguments on both sides.
Free education could reduce inequality.
h: Ikkala tomonni ko'rsatib, xulosangizni ayting.

q: How have family roles changed in recent decades?
ph: Fathers are much more involved in childcare now.
More women work full-time than before.
h: Taqqoslash: compared to..., than they used to.

q: Is it better to have one career for life or to change jobs often?
ph: Changing jobs can help people grow faster.
But staying in one place builds deep expertise.
h: Ikki yo'lni taqqoslang, so'ng o'z tanlovingizni asoslang.

q: Why do people enjoy spending time in nature?
ph: It's a break from noise and screens.
Studies suggest it lowers stress.
h: Ehtiyotkor ilmiy da'vo: Studies suggest..., research indicates...

q: What problems can tourism cause for local residents?
ph: Rents can rise sharply in popular areas.
Overcrowding can spoil the local way of life.
h: Muammolar: overtourism, rising prices, pollution.

q: Do advertisements influence what people buy?
ph: Much more than people like to admit.
Even young children recognize brands.
h: Kuchli fikr va misol: Much more than we realize.
